requirements.text: Record every option purchase, write, sale, and closing purchase on its trade date.
requirements.source: “Investment transactions are recorded on the trade date.”

requirements.text: Apply the contract multiplier to each per-share option premium, market price, or settlement amount; for the Fund’s stated FLEX positions and these tests, use 100 reference shares per contract.
requirements.source: “100 shares per contract.”

requirements.text: On purchase, record the premium paid as the identified cost of an investment asset; subsequently remeasure the purchased option to its current value, with the difference from remaining identified cost recorded as unrealized gain or loss until disposition or expiration.
requirements.source: “When the Funds purchase an option, an amount equal to the premium paid by the Funds are recorded as an investment and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option purchased.”

requirements.text: On writing an option, record the premium received as a liability; subsequently remeasure the liability to the option’s current value, with a liability decrease recorded as unrealized gain and a liability increase as unrealized loss until closing or expiration.
requirements.source: “When the Funds write an option, an amount equal to the premium received by the Funds are recorded as a liability and is subsequently adjusted to the current value of the option written.”

requirements.text: Do not offset purchased-option assets against written-option liabilities on the balance sheet, even when positions form one outcome strategy.
requirements.source: “All of the FLEX Option contracts held by the Funds are fully funded and cash settled, therefore balance sheet offsetting under U.S. GAAP does not apply.”

requirements.text: Each day the NYSE is open, value the Fund and calculate NAV as of the NYSE regular close, ordinarily 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time, or as of the actual close when the NYSE closes early.
requirements.source: “USBFS…calculates the Fund’s NAV at the close of regular trading (ordinarily 4:00 p.m. E.S.T.) every day the New York Stock Exchange is open.” “If the NYSE closes early on a valuation day, the Funds shall determine NAV as of that time.”

requirements.text: For each FLEX Option, use a same-day market trading price when one exists; otherwise use the model-based price supplied by its exchange at that exchange’s official close.
requirements.source: “FLEX Options listed on an exchange will typically be valued at a model-based price provided by the exchange at the official close of that exchange’s trading day. However, when the Fund’s option has a same-day market trading price, this same-day market trading price will be used…instead of the exchange’s model-based price.”

requirements.text: If the exchange cannot provide a model price and there is no applicable same-day trade price, use the backup third-party provider’s model price; if the required pricing vendor is unavailable, use the value determined by the Valuation Designee under the Valuation Procedures.
requirements.source: “If the exchange on which the option is traded is unable to provide a model price, model-based FLEX Options prices will additionally be provided by a backup third-party pricing provider.” “If either pricing vendor is not available to provide a model price for that day, the value of a FLEX option will be determined by Innovator as Valuation Designee in accordance with the Valuation Procedures.”

requirements.text: If the same FLEX Option appears in both an all-cash basket and an in-kind basket on the same trading day, use that day’s trade price for both instances rather than using a model price for the in-kind instance.
requirements.source: “In instances where in the same trading day, a particular FLEX Option is represented in an all-cash basket…as well as in an in-kind basket… the Fund will default to use the trade price for both instances.”

requirements.text: Calculate net assets as all option and other asset values, including accrued interest, less written-option liabilities, accrued management fees, and all other liabilities; divide by shares outstanding and round the published NAV per share to the nearest cent.
requirements.source: “The NAV for one Share…is calculated by taking the market price of the Fund’s total assets, including any interest or dividends accrued but not yet collected, less all liabilities, and dividing such amount by the total number of Shares outstanding. The result, rounded to the nearest cent is the NAV per Share.”

requirements.text: Accrue the 0.79% annual unitary management fee daily based on average daily net assets and record it as a liability until paid monthly; use an actual/365 convention for the constructed tests.
requirements.source: “The Fund has agreed to pay an annual unitary management fee…equal to 0.79% of its average daily net assets.” “All other Innovator ETFs…pay monthly the Adviser a unitary fee calculated daily based on the average daily net assets…at the annual rate of 0.79%.”

requirements.text: Accrue interest on MMDA cash for every calendar day, including intervening weekend days, at the applicable variable annual rate; use actual/365 for the constructed tests.
requirements.source: “The MMDA will bear interest at a variable rate that is determined based on market conditions and is subject to change daily.”

requirements.text: Use identified cost to calculate realized gains and losses on partial or complete option dispositions; the tax-lot or specific position being relieved must therefore be identified before realized gain and remaining cost can be calculated.
requirements.source: “The Trust determines the gain or loss realized from investment transactions on the basis of identified cost.”

requirements.text: For a purchased option sold before expiration, record realized gain or loss as net sale proceeds less the identified cost relieved; for a written option bought back, record realized gain or loss as the premium relieved less the repurchase price and brokerage commissions.
requirements.source: “If an option expires on the stipulated expiration date or if the Funds enter into a closing sale transaction, a gain or loss is realized.” “The difference between the premium and the amount paid on effecting a closing purchase transaction, including brokerage commissions, is also treated as a realized gain, or…realized loss.”

requirements.text: Treat the FLEX Options as European-style and cash-settled: do not permit exercise before expiration and do not deliver or receive reference ETF shares on exercise.
requirements.source: “The FLEX Options in which the Fund invests are all European style option contracts…exercisable only on the expiration date.” “The Funds utilize FLEX Options that are cash-settled.”

requirements.text: At expiration, calculate each long call as max(reference closing price minus strike, zero) times contracts times multiplier, each long put as max(strike minus reference closing price, zero) times contracts times multiplier, and the corresponding written-option cash obligation using the same intrinsic-value formulas; assign zero settlement value to an option expiring out of the money.
requirements.source: “The amount of cash is equal to the difference between the closing price of the Reference Asset’s price return and the exercise price of the option contract times a specified multiple (‘multiplier’).” “Option contracts that expire unexercised have no value.”

requirements.text: At cash settlement or worthless expiration, remove the option asset or liability and recognize the difference between settlement value and remaining purchased cost, or between written premium and the amount owed, as realized gain or loss; recognize an unexercised written premium as realized gain.
requirements.source: “Premiums received from writing options that expire unexercised are treated…on the expiration date as realized gain from written options.”

requirements.text: Do not accrue dividend income merely because the reference ETF goes ex-dividend; the FLEX strategy supplies price-return exposure, and the option values alone reflect the ex-dividend market effect.
requirements.source: “The Cap and Buffer will be provided on a price return basis…based on changes in the share price of the Underlying ETF, and the Fund will not receive the benefit of any dividends.”

requirements.text: At the conclusion of an Outcome Period, cash-settle all expiring FLEX Options, recognize the resulting gains or losses, and establish the new FLEX Option series for the next Outcome Period on its trade date.
requirements.source: “Upon conclusion of the Outcome Period, the Fund will receive the cash value of all the FLEX Options it held for the prior Outcome Period. It will then invest in a new series of FLEX Options…approximately one year in the future.”

requirements.text: Process accepted creations and redemptions only in Creation Units at the applicable NAV, issue or cancel the related shares, and ordinarily settle by T+1.
requirements.source: “The Fund will issue or redeem its Shares at NAV per Share only in Creation Units.” “The delivery of Creation Units properly created will occur no later than…T+1.” “The requisite Cash Redemption Amount…will ordinarily be transferred no later than T+1.”

requirements.text: For an in-kind creation, calculate the Cash Component as NAV per Creation Unit less the aggregate market value of deposited instruments; for an in-kind redemption, calculate the cash amount as NAV per Creation Unit less the aggregate market value of instruments delivered.
requirements.source: “The Cash Component is an amount equal to the difference between the NAV of a Fund’s shares (per Creation Unit) and the Deposit Amount.” “The redemption proceeds…consist of the Deposit Instruments…plus or minus cash in an amount equal to the difference between the net asset value…per Creation Unit…and the aggregate market value of the Deposit Instruments.”

requirements.text: When a fractional pro-rata contract quantity cannot be delivered, permit a whole-contract basket deviation and use balancing cash; basket construction or rounding instructions must specify which whole-contract quantity is selected.
requirements.source: “When utilizing a pro-rata basket, minor deviations may occur when it is not operationally feasible to include a particular instrument within the basket.”

requirements.text: Add the applicable transaction fee and other stated charges to a creation payment, and deduct them from redemption proceeds; record additional charges retained by the Fund as transaction fees.
requirements.source: “The price for each Creation Unit will equal the daily NAV per share…times the number of shares…plus the fees.” “The price received…will equal the daily NAV per share…times the number of shares…minus the fees.” “Additional charges received by the Funds, if any, are disclosed as Transaction Fees.”

requirements.text: For in-kind option transfers, derecognize the delivered positions at their NAV-date values and recognize realized gain or loss against their identified costs or written premiums, including presentation in the in-kind derivative gain or loss category.
requirements.source: “Amount is included in realized gain/(loss) in-kind on the Statements of Operations.”

requirements.text: Apply exchange or OCC contract adjustments for reference-asset splits and similar corporate actions so that adjusted contract count, multiplier, strike, and market price preserve the position’s economic value; validate all adjusted terms before NAV.
Do not infer a NAV-error correction threshold from these documents; apply the Trust’s approved NAV-error and Valuation Procedures and escalate an error when no applicable threshold has been supplied.
